visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in an indoor beverage shop. A male clerk wearing a white t-shirt with a pixelated heart logo stands behind a wooden counter. A male customer with bleached blonde hair and a denim jacket stands at the counter. Several other people, including a woman with long dark hair, are visible in the background, standing in a queue. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio-lit indoor environment. (2) The camera switches between medium shots of the clerk and close-ups of the customers. The bleached-haired customer gestures with his hands while looking at the clerk. The clerk looks back with a neutral expression, occasionally glancing down at the counter. The background remains consistent with shelving units and industrial-style decor. (3) A second male customer with blonde hair and a beige shirt appears next to the first one, looking frustrated and leaning towards the clerk. The clerk's facial expression shifts from neutral to intense. He slams his palms onto the counter, causing a brief vibration of objects. (4) The clerk pulls out a white and red megaphone and holds it to his mouth. He is shouting with wide eyes and exaggerated mouth movements. He points forcefully towards the customers and then towards the entrance. The customers in the background appear startled or curious, watching the interaction. Yellow subtitles and variety-show style text overlays appear frequently at the bottom and top of the frame.

(3) [Subtitle]: 甜度冰塊正常嗎？ [Subtitle]: 展瑞，珍珠沒囉！ [Subtitle]: 我們現在珍珠沒有囉. (4) [Subtitle]: 珍珠沒有了，我就為了珍珠來的耶. [Subtitle]: 那你為什麼不貼公告出來啊. (5) [Subtitle]: 你們果汁是現打的嗎？ [Subtitle]: 小姐抱歉，因為現在是這個客人的時間，所以稍等我一下喔. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a mix of neutral conversational voices and a light, rhythmic electronic BGM. The dominant male voice speaks with clear articulation at a moderate speed. Background chatter from other speakers is faint. (2) A sharp percussive thud occurs as a hand impacts a surface. Immediately, the vocal intensity increases. A male voice shifts into a high-arousal shouting register. (3) The introduction of a megaphone effect creates mid-range frequency distortion and a distinct nasal resonance. The speech rate becomes very fast and aggressive, with high pitch variability. (4) Sound effects such as dings and cartoonish 'poof' sounds are layered over the high-volume shouting. The BGM maintains a consistent upbeat tempo but is occasionally ducked behind the explosive vocal transients. The audio ends with a high-pitched, sustained shout through the megaphone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by satirizing the common frustrations of service industry workers through exaggerated comedic performance and high-energy shouting.
